race.comment: Excited to see AUTUMN GLOW (8) come down to Flemington and play away from home for the first time. There's little doubt she's the best horse in Australia and up there with the best milers in the world. She's completely bombproof off slow or fast tempos and on all ground and J-Mac should have plenty of time to think of his finishing post salute. Outside of her there's a group of them with similar chances. TOM KITTEN (1) couldn't run down LINDERMANN (2) in the Craven Plate last time, LINDERMANN afforded another very easy lead but winning well. TOM KITTEN is an All Star Mile winner here and LINDERMANN flopped in Melbourne, albeit that was Caulfield and Flemington should suit better. LINDERMANN doesn't want the rain. Speaking of flops, SEPALS (4) has gone awfully his past two runs in Sydney. 2nd to Angel Capital in a high pressure Rupert Clarke fresh says he can bounce back. BUCKAROO (3) was excellent from a hopeless spot here last time and will be running on.
